pack.name: Arbit Essentials — Generative Shaders
pack.author: Arbit
pack.description: Five original, dependency-free generative shaders for the Arbit Media Machine, covering every reactivity source: the Block A clock, Block B audio analysis, and the Block C symbolic score / JI lattice. Drop a .fs into a shader generator clip (or import it) and it animates in the viewport and exports identically. Public domain (CC0).

shaders.name: Aurora Drift
shaders.description: Flowing aurora curtains that scroll with the beat and bloom with the low end, over a twinkling star field. Works with no notes — pure clock + audio.

shaders.name: Prime Lattice
shaders.description: Plots every sounding note on the just-intonation lattice by its 3-limit / 5-limit prime exponents, drawing harmonic links as crisp luminous edges. Roots glow gold and mix transients flare the active notes.

shaders.name: Spectrum Rings
shaders.description: A radial spectrum analyzer: bass lights the core, treble the rim, and a moving ring traces the loudest band. Rotates slowly with the beat.

shaders.name: Pulse Grid
shaders.description: A synthwave perspective grid that flashes on every beat, accents each bar's downbeat, and runs a timeline sweep. Pure clock reactivity with an optional loudness lift.

shaders.name: Harmonic Bloom
shaders.description: Each sounding note opens a petal at its exact frequency ratio to the project root. JI commas reshape and recolor the flower; velocity and transients control brightness while the bloom rotates with the beat.
